SCE.S:437854: Strange cases keep him from sleeping. Last night he saw a five-armed monster in the library. A dream?
SCE.S:437920: The government can't agree how to go public. Many Info Ministry staff are here investigating.
SCE.S:4379EC: Moved to a desk job this April. Lost in paperwork, and the City's state has frayed his nerves.
SCE.S:437AB8: 20 years on the force. Tactless and arrogant; even colleagues avoid him. Not a very good cop.
SCE.S:437B84: Famous detective of many tough cases; old-school legwork. These serial cases baffle him.
SCE.S:437C50: Ex-police chief. Keeps the City calm on the surface. Hobby: keeping up appearances.
SCE.S:437D1C: Since junior high he has lived as if dreaming. One dream ended, and the next began.
SCE.S:437DE8: Mild-mannered. Spends days off watching a week of taped anime.
SCE.S:437EB4: Chief's nephew. After seeing a doctor for a cold, his leg swelled hugely within 3 hours.
SCE.S:437F80: Cornered by mutants, he fled in here. Two days without food, living on toilet water.
SCE.S:450008: Come out! Released on parole for lack of evidence. I'm Odagiri. I'm investigating the string of incidents in town. Isn't what you did connected with the other cases?
SCE.S:4503C0: Incidents have been happening all over town these past few days. We police have our hands full! Please, don't cause any trouble. Now, sign the papers! This, this, and this one. This one too.... You may be contacted later, but that's all for today.
SCE.S:45051C: This is the City Central Police Station. If you have business, fill in your request on the form and wait for your number to be called.
SCE.S:4505D8: Please go home for today! The receptionist has his hands full by himself.
SCE.S:450664: The newspaper? The town is full of incidents, isn't it! You should double the social pages!
SCE.S:450910: You know what's happening in town, don't you? ...Won't you tell me! All the townspeople seem to have lost their minds at once. I can't make out any motive at all! So there's nothing we can do! ...For a while, please hold back reporting on the incidents.
SCE.S:450ACC: ...People are mutating? ...I can't believe it... is what I'd like to say, but I've seen something inexplicable myself. At a crime scene I saw the body of a dog with strange protrusions. I'm sure I sent it to forensics, but it got lost somewhere. ...But if that's so, there's nothing the police can do.
SCE.S:450C40: If you have business with the police, please come to the center counter.
SCE.S:450CD8: If you need something, wait outside the counter! We're busy here!
SCE.S:450D90: Hey, you can't come in this far! A newspaper guy? The public relations people are all out!
SCE.S:450E54: Authorized personnel only beyond this point!
SCE.S:450F04: The bodies we sent to forensics keep disappearing one after another! Bodies walking out of the police station? That can't be. We've tightened security, but evidence goes missing too! I even start to feel like no incident ever happened in the first place.
SCE.S:451320: The police are short of hands lately, too. Honestly, we're falling apart.
SCE.S:45486C: {6}A monster in the back? What nonsense! This is a police station!
SCE.S:454980: {6}The police are under our control! We are still a minority. We want to keep managing the town until we gain enough understanding. We want to hold casualties to a minimum, but some are unavoidable! You'll agree on this point, won't you? You yourself have killed many people with no connection to this. So, you die now! You're in the way!
SCE.S:454C28: {6}You seem to keep acting foolishly. Killing people who have nothing to do with it! What we do is the minimum necessary killing, properly managed, but what you do is just a massacre driven by savage fighting instinct! For the town and for humanity's future, I'll kill you here and now!
SCE.S:454E78: {6}You really chase everything too far, don't you.
SCE.S:454F04: {6}I haven't had such a clear head in five years. I know exactly what I should do now! I just have to take you down!
SCE.S:45503C: The {7}Central Police Station{2} is a monster's nest. This is the {8}key{2} here. Let's get out, carefully!
SCE.S:4587A8: Public order is gradually recovering. This station has also come under direct national jurisdiction. ...But many cases will probably remain unsolved.
SCE.S:4588E8: Hello, how's the newspaper? As for me, the paperwork to submit to the government is enormous. It comes to about an encyclopedia. What really happened, nobody truly knows.
SCE.S:458A28: From the newspaper? Please tell me everything you know about what happened in town! I'm with the government's Information Ministry. I came to investigate the town.
SCE.S:458B10: The police have taken heavy losses these past few days. Two close colleagues died!
SCE.S:458BC8: With one big incident after another lately, you can write plenty of articles, can't you? As a newspaperman, aren't you secretly happy?
SCE.S:458C94: Authorized personnel only beyond this point!
SCE.S:458F3C: Now that the town has fallen into ruin, I'm worried crime will spike.
SCE.S:45C780: {6}I've been a cop for years, but in this world I'm a rookie. It's getting to me!
